task_description: Consensus plan for media playback bug fixes from deep-interview spec

architect_review.summary: Approved after narrowing the refactor around one canonical preview owner, explicitly scoping persistence to currentTime continuity, and requiring current-page preservation across resize/orientation transitions.

critic_review.summary: Plan now has grounded file references, testable acceptance criteria, concrete verification commands, bounded alternatives, and explicit Ralph/Team follow-up guidance.

notes: Strengthened plan around canonical preview ownership.
Clarified fullscreenchange/native fullscreen event handling and page-preservation boundaries.
Acceptance criteria and verification are concrete.
Resize-vs-document-reset boundary is now covered in both PRD and test spec.
